headline: When did India begin latest round of talks with Russia, Ukraine? Jaishankar reveals
content: The minister said that from the very beginning, India has held that this conflict is unlikely to be resolved on the battlefield. Therefore, it was important to have negotiations between the parties There were actually negotiations in the early stages of the conflict. Though we have been maintaining for some time that both parties should come to the table, and there were a number of conferences where countries gathered to express their support for peace, but often they would gather in the absence of Russia, he said, in reference to initiatives like the Swiss peace conference. However, he added that New Delhi has always believed that there was no point of having a gathering dealing with the Ukraine conflict where Russia is not there. He said New Delhi started the latest round of conversations with both sides in July this year, after commercial ships came under attack from both sides in the Black Sea. In fact, after losing Indian sailors in such attacks, New Delhi had strongly conveyed its condemnation to both sides and also summoned envoys to register protest. In July, there were attacks on civilian shipping by both Russia and Ukraine. And in the course of those attacks, some Indian sailors were killed, some were injured. We regard these attacks as completely unacceptable, whether it is in the Black Sea, the Red Sea, or the Gulf. So, we protested very strongly to the Russians, to the Ukrainians. I myself took it up with the foreign ministers of both countries. We started getting active initially to secure the maritime shipping and the mariners involved in that, he said. Jaishankar added that those conversations brought out the nature of the cargo which was being shipped. And there was the concern expressed about the grain exports which had come to a halt in the Black Sea. So the conversation developed into whether non-attack on shipping is good, but is there a possibility of facilitating the shipment of grain it got linked to energy. So, it became a somewhat broader conversation, added the minister. The conversations started with Prime Minister Narendra Modis meeting with Russian President Vladimir Putin in Bishkek in August. After that, Jaishankar went to Kyiv to meet Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, which was followed by another discussion between Modi and Putin in New Delhi on the sidelines of the BRICS Summit. We still keep in touch with both sides. Its not obviously an easy situation. Its not something which anybody can say with a high degree of confidence that something is going to come out. But it seems definitely an effort worth making, he says, adding that resolving concerns about grain, fertiliser and fuel are in Indias as well as the Global Souths interest. We have the interests of the parties themselves that if they can even agree on something of a limited nature, we feel that in the given circumstance thats a big positive, he said. He also spoke about the need to fix the United Nations, not work around it, and how this was going to be an age of flux for the world, with conflicts and tariff volatility making it turbulent, underlining that responding to the challenges emerging out of the choppy waters is the task at hand. Im very confident that we will rise to the challenges, Jaishankar said during an interactive session at the 5th Kautilya Economic Conclave in New Delhi, where he shared the dais with former foreign minister of Singapore, George Yong Boon Yeo, during the closing session. The minister, however, said that as Indias record shows, we have been able to rise to the challenges, whether it was Covid, or the challenge of a double conflict today. The challenges of energy, food, fertilisers we need to factor them into our thinking, plan and respond. That in a sense is the task before us. And Im very confident that we will rise to the challenge, he said. Jaishankar also spoke about championing the voice of the Global South. The Global South expects India to articulate on the world stage, he said. On reforms needed for the United Nations and other multilateral institutions, Jaishankar said, The UN is gridlocked, adding that a few countries were resisting its reforms. However, he said that the US is one of Indias principal strategic partners our largest economic account, our biggest trade account, it is a very major critical defence partner.

headline: International Criminal Court Unseals Arrest Warrants Against Four Taliban Leaders Over Alleged Gender Persecution
content: The ICC has unsealed arrest warrants against four senior Taliban leaders over alleged crimes against humanity linked to the persecution of women and girls in Afghanistan. The International Criminal Court (ICC) has unsealed arrest warrants against four senior Taliban leaders over alleged crimes against humanity linked to the persecution of women and girls in Afghanistan. The warrants name Taliban Supreme Leader Akhundzada, Haqqani, Nadim and Agha, who are accused of alleged gender based persecution. - Israel Was Prepared To Shoot Down Flydubai Plane With 150 Israelis Aboard After Cockpit Attack: Report - Ship Carrying Indians Sinks In Black Sea After Catching Fire, Captain Killed; Zelenskyy Blames Russia - Military Regime Vs Taliban Regime: Pakistan, Afghanistan Trade Barbs At Moscow Talks - British Airways London-Chicago Flight Declares Emergency Over Ireland, Descends To 9,000 Feet The ICCs action marks a major legal development in its Afghanistan case, bringing the Taliban leadership under scrutiny over allegations concerning the treatment of women and girls. Four Taliban Leaders Named The arrest warrants have been issued against Taliban Supreme Leader Akhundzada and three other senior leaders, Haqqani, Nadim and Agha. The four face allegations of crimes against humanity over the alleged persecution of women and girls in Afghanistan. Alleged Persecution Of Women And Girls The ICC has targeted the Taliban leadership over allegations of gender based persecution. The case focuses on alleged crimes against humanity committed against Afghan women and girls. The unsealing of the four arrest warrants escalates the ICCs investigation into Afghanistan and places senior Taliban leaders under an international legal spotlight. The four senior Taliban leaders face arrest warrants for alleged crimes against humanity linked to the gender-based persecution of women and girls in Afghanistan.

headline: Ship Carrying Indians Sinks In Black Sea After Catching Fire, Captain Killed; Zelenskyy Blames Russia
content: Romanian authorities confirmed two casualties and said 11 others were rescued after the 139-metre (455 feet) long Royad Mammadov caught fire. Two crew members were killed after a Turkish-owned ship, with Azerbaijani and Indian nationals on board, caught fire in the Black Sea, which has become a frequent site of drone attacks amid the Russia-Ukraine war. Reacting to the incident, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky blamed Moscow for the tragedy and said two Russian drones carried out a horrific strike" on the civilian vessel carrying corn in neutral waters. - Russia Strikes Ukraine, 14 Killed; Lavrov Meets German FM For First Time Since 2022 - India Steps Into Russia-Ukraine Peace Push: Kyiv Praises Modis Proposal | Super Saturday Debate - Why Is Ukraine Weighing To Legalise Pornography Amid War With Russia? - 'Moving Beyond Advocacy': Jaishankar Confirms India-Led 'Ongoing Discussions' To End Ukraine War A horrific strike by two Russian drones on a civilian vessel in neutral waters carrying corn," Zelenskyy said in a post on X. Zelenskyy said the ships captain was killed in the strike. Romanian authorities confirmed two casualties and said 11 others were rescued after the 139-metre (455 feet) long Royad Mammadov caught fire. The interior ministry said the ship sank about 30 nautical miles south of the fishing port of Sfantu Gheorghe, AFP reported. 11 Rescued After Fire On Turkish-Owned Ship Of the 11 rescued, three crew members sustained injuries while eight were unharmed. At around 11:00, Coast Guard border police officers were informed that a fire had broken out on board a commercial vessel located within Romanias exclusive economic zone," the ministry said in a statement. Two crew members were killed after a Turkish-owned ship caught fire in the Black Sea. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky blamed Russia for the incident, stating two Russian drones carried out a strike. Romanian authorities confirmed two casualties and rescued 11 others from the 139-meter Royad Mammadov. The ship sank about 30 nautical miles south of the fishing port of Sfantu Gheorghe. The Turkish Chamber of Maritime Commerce reported 226 civilian and commercial ships attacked in the Black Sea since the war began. Eleven crew members have been rescued. Two deceased persons have also been identified," it added. Drone attacks have become more common in eastern Europe as Ukraine continues its war against Russia, with both sides increasingly using drones. The Black Sea has also emerged as a growing security concern for commercial shipping. Turkey has raised concerns over attacks involving its vessels and sailors. The Turkish Chamber of Maritime Commerce (IMEAK) said 226 civilian and commercial ships had been attacked in the Black Sea since the war began, with most incidents reported this year. President Recep Tayyip Erdogan called the attacks unacceptable". Ukraine has repeatedly proposed concrete steps to de-escalate the situation and ensure security in the Black Sea," Zelensky said on Monday, adding that pressure is needed to restore global food security". A Turkish-owned commercial vessel, the Royad Mammadov, caught fire after being struck by two Russian drones while carrying corn in neutral waters, resulting in it sinking about 30 nautical miles south of Sfantu Gheorghe.

headline: BSP Chief Mayawati Forgives Akash Anand, Reappoints Him As National Coordinator
content: The BSP's move comes months ahead of the Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections, scheduled to be held next year. Days after publicly apologising and seeking forgiveness, BSP chief Mayawatis nephew Akash Anand has been taken back into the Bahujan Samaj Party and reappointed as its National Coordinator. The decision restores him to the key organisational post, months ahead of the Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections scheduled to be held next year. Mayawati announced the decision on Monday, ending Akashs expulsion from the party. From expulsion to re-induction - BJP Announces Candidates For UP Rajya Sabha Polls, Dharampal Singh, Shruti Gangwar Among 8 Names - Hardeep Singh Puri, BL Verma Among 8 Sitting MPs Dropped From BJP's Candidate List For UP Rajya Sabha Polls - UP Congress Gets New Chief! Aradhana Mishra Takes Charge, Imran Masood Gets Key Post | - Who Is Aradhana Mishra? MP Pramod Tiwaris Daughter Takes Over As UP Congress Chief Akash Anand was removed from all organisational responsibilities on September 3. A week later, on September 10, he was completely freed" from the BSP, effectively ending his association with the party. His return came after he publicly appealed to Mayawati for another opportunity to work under her leadership. On October 2, Akash posted an open letter on X in which he described Mayawati as his political mentor, inspiration and like a mother". He said his earlier silence on social media had been misunderstood and sought forgiveness from the BSP chief. Three days later, Mayawati decided to take him back into the party and appointed him National Coordinator once again. Why Mayawati had expelled Akash Mayawati had accused Akash of giving priority to family ties over party discipline. She had pointed to his failure to repost one of her social media posts concerning his father-in-law, former Rajya Sabha MP Ashok Siddharth, as an indication of divided loyalty. Mayawati later expelled Siddharth from the BSP as well. She had said Akash appeared to be acting under his father-in-laws influence. In his October 2 apology, Akash backed Mayawatis decision to expel Siddharth. He said he had distanced himself from social media at the time and, therefore, could not repost Mayawatis post. Akash said his silence had been misunderstood and had led to rumours. He also asked for forgiveness if his actions had hurt Mayawati. He reaffirmed that the BSP was his family" and ruled out joining any other political party. Third expulsion and return since 2024 Akashs latest re-induction is not the first time Mayawati has removed him from the BSP and later brought him back. Reports note that this is his third expulsion-and-return cycle since 2024. His earlier sackings and reinstatements were also linked to concerns over perceived disloyalty and the influence of his father-in-law. The latest return comes at a significant time for the BSP, with the Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections due next year. Mayawati expelled Akash Anand after accusing him of prioritizing family ties over party discipline and showing divided loyalty by failing to repost a social media update concerning his father-in-law, Ashok Siddharth. She also stated that Akash appeared to be acting under his father-in-law's influence instead of serving party interests.

headline: Indian Railways identifies 11 trains with journeys over 40 hours for special cleanliness monitoring
content: Indian Railways has identified 11 long-distance trains with journey durations of more than 40 hours for enhanced cleanliness. The move is aimed at ensuring that passengers get better housekeeping, cleaner toilets and improved onboard services throughout the journey, rather than only at the originating station. According to a Railway Board letter dated October 3, the identified trains will receive special attention for cleanliness and serviceability during their journeys. Why are these trains being monitored? Long-distance trains remain on the tracks for several days. During such extended journeys, issues related to coach cleanliness, toilets, garbage disposal and minor repairs can affect the passenger experience if they are not addressed on time. The Railway Board (RB) has asked the concerned zones to closely monitor these trains while they are en route. The focus will be on maintaining cleanliness throughout the journey until the train reaches its destination. The list includes some of the countrys longest-running trains, including the Vivek Express, Avadh Assam Express, Amrapali Express and Jhelum Express. The Vivek Express has the longest journey among the identified trains, covering about 4,158 km, while its rake turnaround time is 170 hours. WHICH 11 TRAINS HAVE BEEN IDENTIFIED? Trains with the longest turnaround time, identified for maintenance/utilisation review Source: Railway Board |Sl No. |Train Name and No. |Turnround Time |Primary Maintenance |22503/04 Vivek Express |15909/10 Awadh Assam Express |01665/66 RKMP AGTL Express |19483/84 ADI-SHC Express |22365/66 DNR SMVB Express |11401/02 Pune SOU Express |15707/08 Amrapali Express |11077/78 Jhelum Express |13201/02 RGD LTT Express |22831/32 HWH YPR Express |12203/04 ASR Garibrath Express What will Indian Railways do? The Railway Board has directed the zones to take several measures to improve cleanliness and upkeep. The identified trains will be closely monitored by the owning depots during their journeys. Officers will also review cleanliness levels and passenger complaints on a regular basis. Special attention will be given to Clean Train Station (CTS) points, where cleaning teams will be expected to have adequate manpower, equipment and consumables. The RB has also asked for small repairs to be attended to during the journey, while bio-toilets will be checked at maintenance depots and designated en-route locations. - Garbage collection to be monitored Under the onboard housekeeping arrangements, garbage collection is carried out every two hours in coaches. The RB has directed that the collected waste should be handed over at designated disposal points instead of being thrown along the railway track. Time-stamped photographs of coaches and toilets will also be taken at selected inspection points, as well as at originating and destination stations, to help monitor the condition of the trains. - Focus on passenger experience The Railway Board has stressed that the objective is not simply to improve cleanliness when a train starts its journey. In the new OBHS scheme emphasis has been given on the passenger awareness and regular training of OBHS staffs. This need to be emulated in all depots on OBHS trains. The OBHS staffs to be regularly trained for task assigned and proper etiquettes and behavior, the letter reads.

headline: Delhi Police Officer Accused Of Molesting Female Journalist Promoted To Additional DCP Amid Probe
content: Delhi Police ACP Vivek Bhagat, accused by a woman journalist of sexual harassment during a Jantar Mantar protest, has been promoted to Additional DCP amid a Crime Branch probe. Delhi Police ACP Vivek Bhagat, who has been accused of sexually assaulting a woman journalist during a protest near Jantar Mantar, has been promoted to the rank of Additional DCP while the allegations against him are being examined by the Crime Branch. The promotion comes days after three women journalists filed complaints alleging sexual harassment by police personnel during a protest against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar on October 3. The Delhi Police said the complaints were transferred to the Crime Branch for a fair and impartial enquiry". - Delhi Protesters Bus-Stopping 'Stunt' Goes Viral As Internet Mocks Model Pose': 'Everyone Wants A Ticket To Bigg Boss' - Jantar Mantar Protest LIVE: Delhi Police Barricades Roads Amid Anti-CEC Protest Call | Delhi News - Prohibitory Orders In Force, Metro Stations Shut: Delhi Beefs Up Security Ahead Of Jantar Mantar Protest - Jantar Mantar Protest Highlights: Atishi, Sanjay Singh Among 700 Detained, Internet Suspended Till 9 PM Amid Section 163 Restrictions What Did The Journalist Allege? One of the journalists specifically named ACP Vivek Bhagat in her complaint. According to her account, Bhagat sexually assaulted her and pushed her back. She later approached the Parliament Street police station seeking to lodge a complaint and an FIR. The allegation has not been independently verified. Two other women journalists also complained of alleged sexual harassment by police personnel during the same protest. Their complaints, along with the first journalists complaint, have been handed over to the Crime Branch, which is expected to record statements and examine the circumstances surrounding the allegations. What Has Delhi Police Said? Amid the allegations, Delhi Police rejected claims circulating on social media that female protesters were physically assaulted. headline: By Election 2026: Bypolls on 6 seats in West Bengal, Tamil Nadu, Puducherry, Assam; Results On Oct 9
content: West Bengal, Tamil Nadu, Puducherry, Assam By Election 2026: The by-elections to five Assembly constituencies across West Bengal, Tamil Nadu and Puducherry, and one Lok Sabha constituency in Assam, will be held on Tuesday, with voting beginning at 7 am. Counting of votes will be held on October 9. The by-elections hold significance following the BJPs victory in West Bengal, ending TMCs 15-year rule, and Vijays TVKs victorious electoral debut in Tamil Nadu, and it remains to be seen how the new leaders have factored in with the electorate. By Election 2026 Live Updates: Follow Here In West Bengal, the Suvendu Adhikari-led BJP government faces its first electoral test after assuming power in the Assembly polls earlier this year. With Nandigram and Rejinagar going to polls, the Opposition faces a tough battle amid candidate withdrawals, arrests and allegations of police pressure on its workers. The Nandigram seat paved the way for the TMCs rise in 2011 following Mamata Banerjees anti-land acquisition movement, and its where Adhikari defeated the TMC supremo in 2021. Adhikari, now chief minister, won Nandigram again in the 2026 Assembly election but retained Bhabanipur, necessitating the bypoll. The BJP has fielded Hasirani Rath, mother of Chandranath Rath, a former aide of Adhikari. Chandranath was shot dead on May 6, two days after the BJP won the Assembly elections. The Mamata Banerjee-led TMC factions nominee Sanchita Pradhan Dey withdrew her name after meeting Adhikari, following which Banerjee, left without a candidate, backed Congress candidate Milan Pradhan and described the move as an effort to strengthen the INDIA bloc. Pradhan was arrested in old cases linked to the 2007 Nandigram land-acquisition agitation but later secured interim bail and returned to campaign. The rival TMC faction led by Ritabrata Banerjee has fielded Mohammad Eteshamul Haque under the envelope symbol and a separate temporary party identity. The CPI has nominated Santigopal Giri. The by-election in Rejinagar was necessitated after Humayun Kabir, who won both Rejinagar and Nowda in the 2026 Assembly election, retained Nowda. His Aam Janata Unnayan Party has fielded his son Golam Nabi Azad. Kabir had won Rejinagar by nearly 59,000 votes. The contest includes BJP nominee Sakharav Sarkar, former Murshidabad district president; Mamata-led TMC candidate Rabiul Alam Chowdhury; rival TMC candidate Safiuzzaman Sheikh; Congress nominee Mohammad Abdullahil Kafi; and CPI(M)s Syed Asad Ali. The two seats in Tamil Nadu, Madurantakam and Dharapuram, saw four-day aggressive campaigning by TVK chief and Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay, as the electoral contest would be crucial for his party. It is a four-cornered contest, with the TVK, DMK, AIADMK and CPI fielding their candidates. Both constituencies were vacated by AIADMK legislators who resigned within weeks of being elected and crossed over to Vijay. The same two leaders Maragatham Kumaravel in Madurantakam and P Sathyabama in Dharapuram are now contesting as TVK candidates. The DMK enters these by-elections without the broad alliance that accompanied it into the Assembly election. The Congress, VCK, MDMK and IUML have moved into Vijays political orbit, while the CPI and CPI(M) are contesting separately. A total of 27 contestants are in the fray for the bypoll at Madurantakam, and a total of 30 contestants are in the fray in the Dharapuram Assembly constituency. In Madurantakam, a total of 2,12, 639 voters will exercise their franchise in 268 polling stations. In Dharapuram, 2,22, 406 electors will exercise their franchise in 282 polling stations. The poll scenario is different in neighbouring Puducherry, where its a test of popularity for the four-month-old NDA government led by veteran N Rangasamy. Although a total of 11 candidates are in the fray, the battle is being seen as a three-cornered one between the ruling AINRC-led NDA, the Congress and its former ally DMK. While AINRC founder and CM Rangasamy has nominated Ashok Anand on behalf of the ruling party and the coalition it leads, the Congress has fielded E Vinayagam, who has the backing of the Tamizhaga Vetri Kazhagam (TVK), which is part of the ruling alliance in neighbouring Tamil Nadu. The DMK nominee is K Sedhu Selvam. CPIs M A Saleem and S Karthikumari of actor-politician Seemans Naam Tamilar Katchi are also fighting the poll battle. The Nagaon Lok Sabha seat in Assam would witness a triangular contest, with the ruling BJP seeking to expand its base in this Muslim-majority constituency, and the Congress going all out to retain the seat by keeping its minority support base intact. The AIUDF, the third prominent party in the fray, is fighting to maintain its influence after it was reduced to two MLAs from 16 in the April Assembly election. A total of 15 candidates, including nine Independents, are contesting the bypoll. Among the key candidates are ex-MLA Sibamoni Bora of the Congress, former IAS officer Devasish Sharma of the BJP and sitting MLA Badruddin Ajmal of the AIUDF. The bypoll was necessitated after sitting MP Pradyut Bordoloi quit the Congress to join the BJP ahead of the Assembly elections earlier this year. Out of the eight Assembly segments under the Nagaon Lok Sabha seat, the BJP won four, the Congress three and Raijor Dal one in this years state elections. For the Congress, which won three out of 14 Lok Sabha seats in the 2024 election, retaining Nagaon is crucial to prevent further erosion of its support base. The BJP, which has been aiming to spread its base among the Muslims, has viewed the Nagaon bypoll as an attempt to establish its presence across all sections of people and further strengthen its hold in the state.

headline: Dhinakaran slams TVK-led govt. for "turning a blind eye" to inflation
content: led govt. for turning a blind eye to inflation Amma Makkal Munnetra Kazhagam (AMMK) general secretary T.T.V. Dhinakaran on Monday criticised the Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK)-led government for turning a blind eyeto inflation. In a post on his social media handle, he said it was for third time since the assumption of office by the TVK-led regime in May that the prices of essential commodities had risen. He attributed the development to the reduction in coverage of paddy this year in the wake of the TVK-led regimes inability to secure the States share of water. The present situation had affected the livelihood opportunities of farmers badly. Mr. Dhinakaran pointed out that the governments move to sell onions through fair price shops at a rate of 35 per kg had remained only on paper. He also criticised the observation of Revenue Minister K.A. Sengottaiyan about the quality of rice being supplied to people. He called upon Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay to take steps to protect the interests of marginalised people and ensure the supply of rice and other essential commodities through the public distribution system.

headline: Pallattu Brahmadathan: The Tusker Who Won Kerala's Hearts Is No More
content: The Tusker Who Won Keralas Hearts Is No More The elephant died on October 4, coincidentally on World Animal Day, leaving thousands of elephant lovers and temple festival enthusiasts across Kerala grieving. Five years ago, a video clip of an elephant from Kerala bidding farewell to his late mahout went viral across various platforms. In it, we see an elephant walking down a lane to the verandah of a house to see his 74-year-old mahouts body before it is taken for the last rites. The elephant stands in front of the house and raises his trunk twice in front of the body of his mahout, Kunnakkad Damodaran Nair of Lakkattoor in Kottayam district, fondly called Omanachettan by the natives. - AAP Protests Across Punjab Over ED-CBI Raids, Accuses BJP Of Targeting Mann Govt - Petrol Pump Dispute Turns Deadly: Indian Oil Official Stabbed 7 Times In Maharashtra's Hingoli - 'Youre Doing Your Job': Rahul Gandhi Distributes Water While Supporters Deflate Cops Detention Bus | Watch - Facing Difficulty Breathing: Pregnant Womans Terrifying Call From Under Seemapuri Building Debris Soon, Nairs son, Rajesh, steps out of the house to pat the tusker before resting his head on his tusk. Then a scream from the relatives surrounds the premises, and all those gathered around move to tears. After a few moments, the pachyderm retreats from the courtyard, after paying one last salute to his mahout by once again raising his trunk. Now, the tusker Pallattu Brahmadathan, known for his elegant looks and calm temperament, is no more. The elephant died on October 4, coincidentally on World Animal Day, leaving thousands of elephant lovers and temple festival enthusiasts across Kerala grieving. The tragedy came after he was struck by lightning while resting in a temporary shed near the residence of his owner, Rajesh Pallattu, at Melampara, near Erattupetta in Kottayam district on Sunday evening. Having recently completed his musth period, Brahmadathan had been resting there for the past month. Standing at an impressive 10 feet 2 inches, his striking physical presence and exceptionally calm temperament made Brahmadathan an integral feature of major temple festivals across central Kerala. He was a prominent participant in legendary festivals, carrying Thidambu, the sacred deity, on his head. This included the Paramekkavu temples participation in the Thrissur Pooram, including the famous night Pooram in 2015. The tuskers journey to becoming one of Keralas most celebrated elephants began 28 years ago. Originally a working timber elephant in the dense forests of Arunachal Pradesh, he was brought to Kerala by brothers Pothan Varghese and Chacko of Papalaparambil House in Puthuppally, Kottayam. He was renamed Pallattu Brahmadathan 16 years ago when his ownership was transferred to the Pallattu family. Thousands of elephant lovers gathered at Melampara on October 5 to bid adieu to the tusker, who had brought joy to Keralas festival grounds for several years. The renowned tusker Pallattu Brahmadathan died after being struck by lightning while resting in a temporary shed near his owner's residence at Melampara in Kerala's Kottayam district.

headline: 'Tujh Me Rab Dikhta Hai': Israeli Singer Dedicates Shah Rukh Khan's Song To 'Brave' Capt Smit Machchhar
content: Israeli American musician Itay Benda sang Shah Rukh Khans 'Tujh Mein Rab Dikhta Hai' as a tribute to Captain Smit Machchhar after the Flydubai mid-air attack. An Israeli American musician has found a unique way to thank Indian pilot Captain Smit Machchhar for his courage during the Flydubai flight attack, learning a Hindi song especially for him. Musician Itay Benda recorded a performance of Shah Rukh Khans popular song Tujh Mein Rab Dikhta Hai" as a tribute to Machchhar and Indians around the world. Sharing the gesture after the mid-air attack, Benda described it as his small way of saying thank you". - 'Dream Was To Crash Into Israel': Flydubai Omani Co-Pilot Likely To Face Death Penalty In UAE - On India Visit, Switzerland President Guy Parmelin Discusses Trade, Swiss Bank & Chocolates | Exclusive - Flydubai Terror Plot Unraveled: Chilling Confession Of Omani Co-Pilot Hamam Al-Hammami | - 'Planned Attack Before Landing Job, Then Dropped July Execution': Chilling Details Emerge In Flydubai Case The video has since gained widespread attention on social media, with users praising Benda for choosing a Hindi song and dedicating it to the Indian pilot. Social Media Reaction The song, originally sung by Roop Kumar Rathore, is from Shah Rukh Khans 2008 romantic comedy Rab Ne Bana Di Jodi. Bendas rendition received several appreciative reactions online, with many users thanking him for the gesture and praising his Hindi. The most apt song chosen to give praise and thanks to Capt Smit. What a touching effort to show your love and appreciation," one user commented. Another wrote, Thank you very much from an Indian for singing such an appropriate song." Very appropriate song for the occasion and you sing very well with good Hindi. Thank from all my Indian friends," a third user said. Im impressed by this Israeli- Americans Hindi pronunciation when he sings a tribute to Captain Smit Machchhar. Enjoy the voice of Itay Benda. Dina Shakti (@Dina_Shakti) October 3, 2026 What Happened On The Flydubai Flight? The musical tribute comes days after Captain Machchhar was praised for his actions during a frightening incident aboard Flydubai flight FZ1073. The flight was travelling from Dubai to Tel Aviv on September 30 when the Omani co-pilot allegedly stabbed Machchhar and attempted to interfere with the aircrafts controls. The captain reportedly managed to confront the attacker despite being injured, helping prevent the situation from escalating further. The aircraft was eventually diverted and made an emergency landing in Tabuk, Saudi Arabia. There were 174 people on board the flight, and all of them survived the incident. Machchhar has since received widespread praise for his actions, with the latest tribute from Benda adding a musical touch to the appreciation for the Indian pilot. Itay Benda dedicated Shah Rukh Khan's song 'Tujh Mein Rab Dikhta Hai' to Captain Smit Machchhar as a touching tribute to thank the Indian pilot for his courage and actions during a dangerous mid-air flight attack.

headline: Tiruvottiyur residents seek flood-free, pollution-free neighbourhood
content: free neighbourhood Residents of Tiruvottiyur sought measures to prevent flooding, curb industrial pollution, provide pattas and basic amenities, and strengthen healthcare and waste management at a public assembly held in the area on Sunday. The Federation of North Chennai Residents Welfare Associations (FNCRWA) and the Village Coordination Committee organised the Tiruvottiyur Makkal Sangamam at the Perundalaivar Kamarajar Mandapam. Among the demands were the raising and strengthening of both banks of the Buckingham Canal by one metre, measures to prevent industrial wastewater and thermal power plant ash from entering the canal and estuary, deepening and widening the Ennore estuary to facilitate the discharge of Kosasthalaiyar river water into the sea. Association president T.K Shanmugam also sought expansion of Metrorail to Ennore, completion of the Annamalai Nagar-Wimco railway subway, playgrounds and gymnasiums. A self-certification system was sought for individual houses up to 3,000 sq ft, excluding multi-storey buildings. They sought action against industries violating pollution control rules, including continuous monitoring of air, water and soil quality and transparent disclosure of the findings. The demands also included regular drinking water supply, underground sewerage connections and integrated stormwater drains. They also sought pattas for eligible long-term residents of government and temple lands, while protecting water bodies and catchment areas. Sale deeds were sought for those who had paid for houses built by the Tamil Nadu Urban Habitat Development Board.

headline: From Kadhi-Chawl Cart To Mercedes: Who Is Rajesh 'Nana', Man At Centre Of Dubai-Lined Investment Scam?
content: Lined Investment Scam? The network used fake investment apps, displays of luxury cars and promises of Dubai flats and plots to attract investors. A kadhi-and-chole-chawal cart that once sustained Rajesh Kumar now sits in a corner of his plush farmhouse, while his Mercedes has been seized by police. The man also known as Nana" is now described by Panchkula Police as a key local recruiter in an alleged Haryana-wide investment and cryptocurrency fraud estimated at Rs. 8 crore or more. - FIR Filed Over Assault On Delhi Cop During Kejriwals Visit; AAP's Saurabh Bhardwaj, Jarnail Singh Named - Bihar Man, Female Friend Harassed On Camera In Gaya; Fourth Such Case After Jamui, Samastipur, Banka - 'Fabricated Speculations': Iran Denies Link To UK Airbase Incident; 5 Arrested To Be Released On Bail - Man Accused Of Raping Woman At Gunpoint In Bhubaneswar Attacks Cops, Injured In Encounter From food cart to Senior Project Head Rajesh initially invested Rs. 7,500 and later around Rs. 2 lakh in another platform after Bloom shut down. He then allegedly started bringing other people into similar money-multiplying schemes. Police said he attended seminars in Chandigarh, Mohali and elsewhere where people presented themselves as promoters of investment schemes and encouraged people to invest through meetings and online platforms. Panchkula Police describe Rajesh Kumar as a key local recruiter in an alleged Haryana-wide investment and cryptocurrency fraud. The fraud is estimated at Rs. 8 crore or more. Four men have been arrested so far in the case. Police have seized a Mercedes, an Audi Q5, an Audi Q3, and a BMW linked to the accused. At least six electronic devices, including Apple MacBooks and iPhones, have been seized for forensic examination. Rajesh claimed that he was gifted a Mercedes C-class and earned Rs. 2 crore in a short span," the officer said. Police have seized the Mercedes linked to Rajesh. His farmhouse and other assets are also being examined as potential proceeds of crime. How the racket worked Police said investors were attracted with promises of quick and substantial returns. They were shown rising balances on mobile applications, which investigators believe were manipulated. Investors were shown growing balances on mobile applications and were allegedly led to believe that their money was multiplying rapidly," he said. In one case being examined, an investment of around Rs. 30 lakh allegedly appeared to increase to Rs. 68 lakh in about six months. The network allegedly paid back some small initial investments to build trust, used luxury cars and lifestyle claims to attract more people, and encouraged investors to bring relatives and friends. When investors sought withdrawals, they were allegedly moved to other crypto or investment schemes with promises of higher returns. Police also said investors were repeatedly told that flats had been booked for them in Dubai. The schemes under investigation include Bloom Drive, LPNT Cryptocurrency, MSVP or Meta Soil Verse Plan, SOIL VERSE and Mechai FX. Contractor says he lost Rs. 60 lakh I first invested Rs. 8,500, and they returned the money to me. Then, in 2021, I took a loan and invested Rs. 3.5 lakh. Subsequently, my brothers and other relatives also started investing in the scheme. This way they duped me of 60 lakh," Ashok said. He alleged that 2025 people introduced by him were also unable to withdraw their money. The overall loss suffered by my contacts must be more than around Rs. 7-8 crore," he claimed. These are complainant allegations and have not been adjudicated. Four arrested, Dubai link under probe The four arrested accused are Rajesh Kumar and Udham Singh from Karnal, Sushil Kumar from Yamunanagar and Sanjeev Kumar from Ladwa in Kurukshetra. Sushil, who had reportedly run a security agency before 2019, was arrested at Delhi airport while allegedly preparing to fly to Thailand. Udham Singh and Sanjeev were reportedly unemployed and dependent on family farming. Police have also seized an Audi Q5, Audi Q3 and BMW linked to the accused. They have approached the court seeking permission to auction the vehicles to recover alleged proceeds of crime. At least six electronic devices, including Apple MacBooks, iPhones and other mobile phones, have also been seized and sent for forensic examination. The investigation has now expanded to suspected Dubai-based operators. Police have issued Look-Out Circulars against Ravinder Bangar and Happy Sheikh, whom investigators believe may be in Dubai. Other suspects named include Satish Mokhra, Devinder Bangar, Karamjeet and B S Randhawa. A Look-Out Circular has been issued against Bangar and Sheikh who are believed to be in Dubai," Inspector Yudhveer Singh said. Panchkula Police Commissioner Pankaj Nain has cautioned people against transferring money into online investment, cryptocurrency or stock-trading schemes promising unusually high returns. Rajesh operated a kadhi-and-chole-chawal cart until 2019 before his friend introduced him to an online portal called Bloom Company. After initial investments, he began recruiting others, rose to the position of 'Senior Project Head' through seminars, and allegedly earned Rs. 2 crore.

Following the complaint, police detained the girls parents and launched an investigation into the allegations. The girl has since been placed under the care and protection of the authorities.
